# perfinpy

> Python functions from Personal Finance: a field manual

## Docs

### API Reference

#### Income
> Foundations. Functions from the Income chapter.

- [wealth_formula](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/wealth_formula.html): Wealth from saving part of an income every year
- [fixed_cost_ratio](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/fixed_cost_ratio.html): Fixed costs as a percent of take home pay
- [raise_invested_value](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/raise_invested_value.html): Future value of investing part of a raise

#### Tracking Spending
> Foundations. Functions from the Tracking Spending chapter.

- [apply_rules](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/apply_rules.html): Categorize transactions with keyword rules
- [subscription_opportunity_cost](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/subscription_opportunity_cost.html): What a subscription would grow to if invested instead

#### Budgeting
> Foundations. Functions from the Budgeting chapter.

- [percent_of_income](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/percent_of_income.html): An expense as a percent of income
- [to_annual](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/to_annual.html): Convert a daily, weekly, or monthly amount to a yearly amount
- [to_monthly](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/to_monthly.html): Convert a daily, weekly, or yearly amount to a monthly amount
- [opportunity_cost](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/opportunity_cost.html): What an amount could grow to if invested instead of spent
- [months_to_break_even](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/months_to_break_even.html): Months until monthly savings cover an upfront cost

#### Managing Debt
> Foundations. Functions from the Managing Debt chapter.

- [apr_to_apy](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/apr_to_apy.html): Convert an APR to an annual percentage yield (APY)
- [months_to_payoff](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/months_to_payoff.html): Months to pay off a balance with a fixed payment
- [total_interest](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/total_interest.html): Total interest paid over the life of a loan
- [loan_income_ratio](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/loan_income_ratio.html): Total student loans as a multiple of expected starting salary
- [monthly_standard_payment](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/monthly_standard_payment.html): Monthly payment on a standard student loan repayment plan
- [idr_monthly_payment](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/idr_monthly_payment.html): Income driven repayment (IDR) monthly payment
- [dti_ratio](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/dti_ratio.html): Debt to income ratio
- [payoff_vs_invest](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/payoff_vs_invest.html): Pay off a debt or invest the difference
- [order_avalanche](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/order_avalanche.html): Order debts for the avalanche method (highest APR first)
- [order_snowball](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/order_snowball.html): Order debts for the snowball method (smallest balance first)
- [credit_utilization](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/credit_utilization.html): Credit utilization: a card balance as a percent of its limit

#### Emergency Fund
> Foundations. Functions from the Emergency Fund chapter.

- [emergency_fund_target](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/emergency_fund_target.html): Emergency fund target
- [months_to_ef_goal](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/months_to_ef_goal.html): Months to reach an emergency fund target
- [monthly_contribution_needed](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/monthly_contribution_needed.html): Monthly contribution needed to reach an emergency fund target
- [ef_growth](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/ef_growth.html): Emergency fund balance after earning interest

#### Savings Strategies
> Savings. Functions from the Savings Strategies chapter.

- [savings_rate](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/savings_rate.html): Savings rate: the percent of income not spent

#### High-Yield Savings Accounts
> Savings. Functions from the High-Yield Savings Accounts chapter.

- [hysa_balance](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/hysa_balance.html): High-yield savings account balance

#### Automating Savings
> Savings. Functions from the Automating Savings chapter.

- [monthly_savings](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/monthly_savings.html): Monthly amount to pay yourself first

#### Investing Basics
> Investing. Functions from the Investing Basics chapter.

- [future_value](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/future_value.html): Future value of a single amount with yearly compounding
- [rule_of_72](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/rule_of_72.html): Years for money to double, by the rule of 72
- [future_value_series](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/future_value_series.html): Future value of a fixed contribution made every period
- [real_return](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/real_return.html): Real (inflation adjusted) return

#### Retirement Accounts
> Investing. Functions from the Retirement Accounts chapter.

- [employer_match](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/employer_match.html): Yearly employer match on retirement contributions
- [after_tax_value](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/after_tax_value.html): After tax value of a retirement contribution

#### Index Funds
> Investing. Functions from the Index Funds chapter.

- [yearly_fee](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/yearly_fee.html): Yearly fund fee from an expense ratio
- [future_value_after_fees](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/future_value_after_fees.html): Future value of monthly contributions after fund fees

#### Asset Allocation
> Investing. Functions from the Asset Allocation chapter.

- [portfolio_return](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/portfolio_return.html): Return on a two fund (stock and bond) portfolio
- [rebalance_amount](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/rebalance_amount.html): Amount to buy (positive) or sell (negative) to reach a target

#### Taxes
> Taxes and insurance. Functions from the Taxes chapter.

- [income_tax](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/income_tax.html): Federal income tax for a single filer (2026 brackets)
- [raise_kept](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/raise_kept.html): How much of a raise you keep after federal income tax

#### Insurance
> Taxes and insurance. Functions from the Insurance chapter.

- [break_even_years](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/break_even_years.html): Years of premium savings to cover a higher deductible
- [plan_cost](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/plan_cost.html): Yearly cost of a health plan

#### Financial Goals
> Planning. Functions from the Financial Goals chapter.

- [monthly_for_goal](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/monthly_for_goal.html): Monthly saving needed to reach a goal
- [months_to_fund](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/months_to_fund.html): Whole months to fund a goal with no interest

#### Major Purchases
> Planning. Functions from the Major Purchases chapter.

- [rent_buy_threshold](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/rent_buy_threshold.html): Monthly rent that matches the unrecoverable cost of owning
- [mortgage_payment](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/mortgage_payment.html): Monthly payment on a fixed rate loan
- [first_payment_split](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/first_payment_split.html): Interest and principal in a loan's first monthly payment

#### Estate Planning
> Planning. Functions from the Estate Planning chapter.

- [net_worth](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/net_worth.html): Net worth: total assets minus total debts
- [beneficiary_share](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/perfinpy/reference/beneficiary_share.html): Share of assets that pass directly to a named beneficiary
